brief: A web and mobile campus platform that helps faculty and organization members run events and students check in with QR codes and verified attendance.
criteria: Recognisable as a campus-event identity, legible at app-icon size, and usable in one colour.

concepts.name: The Threshold
concepts.idea: An attendee arrives through an open event threshold.
rationale: Signals showing up and participating, not just scanning technology.
The simplified arch and dot remain distinct in small app and web contexts.
Blue and teal retain continuity with the existing CheckedIn identity.

recommendation: The Threshold connects a real attendee to an open event entrance, with a compact symbol and a wordmark that works across the web and mobile app.
next_steps: Use the horizontal lockup in app headers.
Use the Threshold symbol in mobile launchers and browser tabs.
Keep the approved one-colour and reversed masters for print and dark backgrounds.
